settings.label: BRAND STATUS
settings.value: Fictional Concept · Not a Real Commercial Entity

settings.heading: 01. Fictional Brand & Non-Commercial Status
settings.body: QIRÉLIA—along with its collections (The Permanent Archive and The Reserve Editions), fragrance titles, pricing, SKU codes, batch limits, client profiles, and sample order records—is an entirely fictional concept created for creative and technical exploration. QIRÉLIA does not exist as a real-world company, registered trademark, or retail store. Any resemblance to existing brands, products, or individuals is purely coincidental.

settings.heading: 02. Portfolio & Showcase Usage Only
settings.body: This website, its visual identity, Brand Toolkit 1.0, and interactive storefront prototypes are published strictly for personal portfolio showcase and professional capability demonstration by Sewak Singh (Millé Studio). No portion of this project is intended for commercial sales, public retail distribution, advertising, or commercial licensing.

settings.heading: 03. AI-Generated & AI-Assisted Content Disclosure
settings.body: This project relies extensively on Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools for creative direction and asset production. Visuals—including flacon renders, editorial still-life imagery, macro material textures, video elements, and campaign photography—as well as AI-assisted strategy, copywriting, and sample product metadata may be generated or assisted by AI systems. All AI-created and AI-assisted content is used strictly for conceptual, non-commercial portfolio illustration.

settings.heading: 04. Third-Party Stock Media & Attribution
settings.body: Where curated third-party stock photography, typography, or placeholder media appear alongside AI-generated visuals, all rights remain with their respective creators and platforms under their applicable open or standard licenses. No copyright or ownership is claimed over third-party stock assets, which are included solely to complete realistic portfolio mockups.

settings.heading: 05. No Real Transactions, Checkout, or Payment Processing
settings.body: All e-commerce interfaces on this site—including Add to Bag, Shopping Bag, Checkout, Payment & Billing, Sign In, Account, and Order History pages—are functional UI/UX demonstrations only. No real orders are processed, no funds are charged, and no products will be fulfilled. Visitors must not enter genuine payment card details, banking credentials, or sensitive personal data into any demonstration form.

settings.heading: 06. Fictional Formulations — Not Cosmetic or Regulatory Advice
settings.body: All olfactory pyramids, raw material narratives, concentration ratios (20% Eau de Parfum and 30% Extrait de Parfum), INCI allergen notes, and Class 3 ground shipping descriptions are fictional creative copy written to emulate a luxury fragrance house. No fragrance or formulation has been physically compounded, stability-tested, IFRA-certified, or registered with cosmetic regulators such as US FDA/MoCRA, EU CPNP, or UK SCPN. Nothing on this site constitutes perfumery, cosmetic safety, dermatological, or regulatory advice.

settings.heading: 07. Intellectual Property, Liability & Removal Requests
settings.body: The original website layout, design system, and interaction architecture are presented as portfolio work by Sewak Singh (Millé Studio). This project is provided “as is” for visual and technical demonstration without warranties of any kind. If you are a copyright, trademark, or likeness rights holder and believe any AI-generated or third-party asset used here inadvertently conflicts with your rights, please reach out via the Contact page for immediate review and prompt removal.
